role: Only writer of the kit. Children copy. Portable intakes absorb.
refuse: BOARD.md or board.json from a child
Real people, pay, or client data
A direct write to VirBk/Grok from a child remote

children.name: Otto
children.take: Envelope, landing gate, keystones, idle-is-success, real-data gates.

children.name: Virbos
children.take: Decision register, authority levels, walkthrough as acceptance, derivation containers.

children.name: Next child
children.take: Does not exist until this kit is copied into a new product remote.

intakes.title: Envelope as the only authorization
intakes.charged: Work that started from continue could not be verified.
intakes.rule: No envelope, no code. One page: acceptance, base SHA, holds, check.
intakes.check: Landing refuses a branch whose return does not cite an envelope id.

intakes.title: SESSION_LOG.md as a living file
intakes.charged: Newest-first essays. Nobody could hand off from it.
intakes.rule: Do not create SESSION_LOG.md. Lane logs are a few lines. History is git.
intakes.check: Size budget and a landing-gate glob fail any SESSION_LOG.md.

intakes.title: BOARD.md as hand-edited markdown
intakes.charged: Invented clocks, backticks, f-string braces. Files grew past a sitting.
intakes.rule: factory/board.json is the source. BOARD.md is generated.
intakes.check: renderBoard.mjs --check fails a landing if the markdown drifted.

intakes.title: Gate reads the working tree, tests the commit
intakes.charged: Same SHA gated as different step counts in two trees.
intakes.rule: Parse the check list from a fresh git archive of the commit under test.
intakes.check: landingGate.mjs exits 1 if factory/landing-checks.json is missing from the archive.

intakes.title: Idle is success
intakes.charged: Filling seats created overlapping holds. Conflict resolution is unreviewed code.
intakes.rule: Two writers is a ceiling, not a target. Empty seats stay empty.
intakes.check: The board names disjoint holds before a second sibling launches.

intakes.title: Copied counts in prose
intakes.charged: README quoted rule counts that were wrong by the time they were read.
intakes.rule: Paste from the command that produced the number, with the command, or omit.
intakes.check: Landing gate forbids digits in README/AGENTS/BOARD except in generated tables.

intakes.title: Control plane session pointed at a cheap model
intakes.charged: The harness looked the same. Judgment did not.
intakes.rule: Spawn a writer seat. Do not remap the control-plane session.
intakes.check: Envelope names a runtime. A writer return whose model equals the CP is a stop.

intakes.title: Control plane was a Claude Code window
intakes.charged: A laptop without Anthropic and a cloud Grok session could not run the loop.
intakes.rule: Judgment is Grok or Claude. Hands are a dumb runner. Writer harness is a PM pick in factory/project.json.
intakes.check: hands.mjs --self-test fails a project.json whose pick is not in runtimes.json.

intakes.title: Token-zero treated as no-scope
intakes.charged: A queue name was stamped absent because a markdown-only grep missed the wave table in the same board and the product source.
intakes.rule: A ZERO names every container, including empty ones. Product source is a container. The board's later sections are a container.
intakes.check: node factory/tools/scopeSearch.mjs --self-test fails if a token that lives only in source is reported absent.

intakes.title: Named issuance asked of the owner
intakes.charged: A lane sat blocked on the citation while the board already named the section of the official PDF.
intakes.rule: A named law, circular, IRR, RFC, or PDF is a fetch. Quote it or stamp the miss. Asking the owner is for documents that do not exist.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md is required CP reading. A blocked-on-issuance ledger row without a fetch URL is a diary.

intakes.title: Collection treated as no statute
intakes.charged: Practice still collecting was read as missing law, so the lane could not start.
intakes.rule: An agency still collecting is a second fact. Transcribe the issuance. Do not collapse practice into no legal basis.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md requires both facts stamped. The issuance URL is in the ledger row.
